scientific_integrity: The dimer model and first-edge decomposition are prior work. The exact mixed boundary/global generating function and all-size covariance sign classification are the assessed claim, not the known marginal expectations. Independent verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only uniform random-order length-two adsorption on a finite path; it does not cover cyclic or nonuniform models. The covariance sign and limit follow from a proof with explicit exponential-tail bounds, supported by finite exact checks. General older spatial-correlation treatments may provide alternate derivations and historical priority remains qualified.
title: Boundary vacancy and jammed dimer count on a finite path
